evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep does not frame the call as 10–15 minutes with a dependable quote or ask for a yes before proceeding. Jumps directly into discovery: 'Okay. So in order for me to give you an estimate for your move I just need to ask you more questions about it and then I carry the profile for you.'
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves directly into demographics and address collection without asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Covers: property type (apartment), floor (first), bedrooms (one), parking distance (3 school buses), special items (two couches, two TVs, mattress, dining table, dresser, boxes). Missing: number of additional rooms/rooms in destination, walking distance not revisited, no dedicated special-considerations probe beyond 'Do you have any special instructions or concerns?'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Yes: 'Mm-hmm how many boxes do you have? Do you think it's about fifteen to 25 boxes?' Customer replies 'Maybe.'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full anchor: '...usually it takes two and a half to three and a half hours to complete. But for your move the unique thing about your move is the travel to beta so it can take an hour to an hour and a half depending on traffic... So for now, I will quote your move more on the four to five hour mark, which is an estimated budget of $1,170 including the transportation fee...' Personalized to travel distance and move size.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full transparency: Trip fee ($140) disclosed upfront, 2.5-hour minimum stated, 15-minute increments stated, all inclusions (taxes, credit card fees, assembly/reassembly, insurance, reps, truck) embedded in hourly rate explained. 'The only thing outside of the hourly rate is a one time travel fee of $140 but aside from that everything's already included in the rate.'
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. After pricing, customer raises concern ('so far your company is the expensive one'), rep responds defensively with comparison talk ('just make sure that you check what are the inclusions on their hourly rate cause they might charge you extra...'), then transitions to 'I'll send everything to your email so you can review it as well, okay?' No 'Does that feel fair?' and no silence held.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Fully delivered with discount framing: 'and lastly on time guarantee if we run late on the time we schedule, we provide discounts for your move.'
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Mentioned but missing no-deductible and no-fine-print framing: 'our no worries, damage coverage which would give you up to $2,000 coverage for any accidental damages also meet your mover feature.' Built-in status not explicitly stated; no 'no deductible, no fine print' language.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or confirm both promises landed. Instead transitions to email: 'I'll send everything to your email so you can review it as well, okay?'
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. After pricing and email mention, call ends with 'Okay, alright, yeah, send me the customer my email, please.' / 'Okay. Alright.' No genuine 'What's still concerning you?' or even throwaway 'Any questions?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never. No 'Would you like our help with your move?' Close is transactional: 'I'll send everything to your email so you can review it as well, okay?' and 'Okay, no worries, thanks for calling.'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: None. No booking confirmed at all. Call ends after customer requests the estimate be sent to email. No date, time, crew size, arrival window, or crew notes captured or confirmed.

top_strength: Joanna gathered comprehensive logistics details early (apartment size, floor, distance, itemized inventory, both addresses) and delivered transparent pricing with a personalized travel-time adjustment and full fee disclosure in a single clear explanation.
coaching_note: Critical gap: the call never closes. Joanna never asked the explicit 'Would you like our help with your move?' question, never held silence on pricing, and never booked anything — when the customer asked for the estimate via email, Joanna agreed and the call ended without a booking confirmation or next step captured.
